title: Why Do Fingers Wrinkle in Water?
description:
Your skin is not simply soaking up water—the nervous system actively creates the wrinkles.

Small blood vessels constrict under autonomic control, pulling the fingertip surface into wrinkles.

Some studies suggest wrinkles improve handling of wet objects, but results are mixed, so present the grip benefit as a supported hypothesis rather than settled fact.

Abnormal wrinkling can be used as a clue to autonomic nerve function.
